events.title: PSX Classic
events.notes: Update 99 launched October 24. The official announcement does not specify the final event closing time.

events.title: Fantasy Clan Battle
events.notes: The official post specifies a six-day contest. An exact start/end timestamp is not given; follow the in-game leaderboard countdown.

events.title: Diamond Mountain
events.notes: The official Update 99 post still includes Mountain trails, expeditions and the Yeti. Current closing time is unknown.

timerPresets.title: Mountain expedition
timerPresets.notes: Base expedition returns arrive hourly, including offline. Expedition Speed upgrades may shorten your wait; set the displayed remaining time.

timerPresets.title: Classic Legend playtime
timerPresets.notes: The goal also requires Heavens Gate. This is a manual progress helper, not an in-game read: pause outside PSX Classic and subtract playtime you already have.
